reason: The problem is real (checked 20:30Z). v2 (2) (CONTEXT l.3123-3131) codes each file against the team best B. Since probe 45 (l.3196), B = 0.956, so the clause '0.954 <= display < B -> MASKED' now matters. If probe 46 (exp70q = exp70g + thr 0.3 + fm 4.5; poll.log l.17103: still PENDING, read due ~22:00-22:40Z) displays 0.955, v2 codes it '?'. But on public, a lower display means a strictly lower unrounded score than exp70g. The gap can be anything from 0 to ~0.002, so the finding's '-0.001' overstates it. Files on the exp70b base (exp76a/76d, fallbacks exp75/72 on K2) at 0.955 are also coded '?', and at 0.956 they need an UP over exp70g, even though beating their own 0.954 base is already visible from the display. k = 10 is confirmed: E10 20260927T2002Z.txt l.303, rank 163, 0.956 block starts at 153, and the block is ordered by unrounded score, so the UP test is valid. It costs nothing, adds no mechanism and needs no submit, so R8 is untouched, and it must be logged before 46 reads. The proposed action has two errors. (1) The v2 rows (l.3120) and card (4) ('Either NEG -> drop every exp73* and exp76c/e/g/h/i') key on '46 NEG'. Coding 46 = 0.955 as NEG without rewriting the rows sends W1 to row D and drops the cap-6/DIV line that 45 just proved (P6). (2) The action limits MASKED to '+2 step with equal displays'. That removes the card (1) MASKED case (l.3019: another of our files showed an UP in the same window). With 4-5 cap-6 W1 files completing 07:30-11:00Z on 28 Sep, one 0.956+UP read, or a 46 read of >= 0.957, lifts the team best above exp70g. A later cap-6 file at 0.956 with 0 passed could still beat exp70g, and the proposed rule would code it N. For CI/SEC, N closes the lever, so the fix would bring back the false-close bug it is meant to remove.
fix: Before 46 turns terminal, log 'READ TABLE v3 codes (pre-46)'. Code each ref against its own base: exp70g 0.956 for exp70q/76e/78a/78b/79a/79d, exp70b 0.954 for 76a/76d, K2 0.954 for 75/72. Base 0.954 files: >= 0.955 -> '+', 0.954 -> '?' (UP blind), <= 0.953 -> '-'. Cap-6 base files: >= 0.957 -> '+'; 0.956 + UP -> '+'; 0.956 with 0 passed -> '0' ONLY IF the team's unrounded best is still held by exp70g at S0 (no earlier 0.956+UP and no >= 0.957 by any of our files), else '?'; <= 0.955 -> '-' for that file's increment only. Probe 46 = 0.955 means 'thr 0.3 + fm on cap 6 = -', and DIV/cap 6 stays + from 45. It never triggers row D / 'Either NEG'. Row D fires only if 45 were NEG (it is not). Keep the card (1) MASKED case (another of our files showed an UP in the same window) next to the +2-step case. For CI/SEC, only a '0' read under the exp70g-holder condition closes the lever.
realistic_gain: No score gain. It stops at most one false code of probe 46 and a false '0' (lever close) or '?' on 1-3 of the 28 Sep W1 reads. That protects the W2 max-stack choice and the lever list the user will pick finals from on 29 Sep. Worth ~0-0.001 public through better file choice, private effect unknown; it costs one log line.
